title: Genome object schema
description: JSON schema for validating genome metadata in MetaSBT

dataset_id.title: Dataset ID
dataset_id.description: Identifier of the dataset the genome belongs to

sample_id.title: Sample ID
sample_id.description: Identifier of the sample the genome was assembled from

genome_id.title: Genome Identification
genome_id.description: Unique identifier for the genome within the dataset

genome_type.title: Genome Type
genome_type.description: Metagenome-assembled genome or genome from isolate sequencing

sequence_type.title: Sequence Type
sequence_type.description: Type of sequencing approach used to generate the genome

ncbi_taxid.title: NCBI Taxonomy ID
ncbi_taxid.description: Direct NCBI taxonomy identifier for the genome

sha256.title: File SHA-256 Hash
sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the genome file

file_path.title: Relative Genome File Path
file_path.description: Relative path to the genome file within the database

taxonomy.title: Taxonomic Label
taxonomy.description: Full taxonomic label from kingdom down to species level

taxonomy_id.title: Taxonomy IDs
taxonomy_id.description: Pipe-separated numeric taxonomy identifiers for each taxonomic level

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Percentage of genome completeness computed by CheckM

contamination.title: Contamination
contamination.description: Percentage of contamination computed by CheckM

strain_heterogeneity.title: Strain Heterogeneity
strain_heterogeneity.description: Percentage of strain heterogeneity computed by CheckM

link.title: External Link
link.description: URL or external reference for the genome

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional tags for the genome object

MAGsQuality.title: MAGs Quality Metrics
MAGsQuality.description: Quality assessment metrics for metagenome-assembled genomes

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Percentage of genome completeness computed by CheckM

contamination.title: Contamination
contamination.description: Percentage of contamination computed by CheckM

strain_heterogeneity.title: Strain Heterogeneity
strain_heterogeneity.description: Percentage of strain heterogeneity computed by CheckM

passes_mimag.title: Passes MIMAG Criteria
passes_mimag.description: Whether the MAG meets the Minimum Information about a Metagenome-Assembled Genome standards

checkm_version.title: CheckM Version
checkm_version.description: Version of CheckM used for quality assessment

Source.title: Genome Source
Source.description: Origin of the genome sequence data

database.title: Source Database
database.description: The database or repository from which the genome was obtained

accession.title: Accession Number
accession.description: Accession identifier in the source database

url.title: Source URL
url.description: URL to the genome entry in the source database

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: Date when the genome was released in the source database
